_comment: Octail's own egg (no upstream file). The headless OpenRCT2 multiplayer server (openrct2-cli) from the official Linux Debian 12 build on GitHub (latest or a tag), checked against the release's sha256sums.txt and GitHub's digest, failures exit non-zero. OpenRCT2 needs the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files, which can't be shipped: the operator uploads them to rct2/ or sets RCT2_DATA_URL to an archive on their own storage (optionally with RCT2_DATA_SHA256); without them the install ends with a note (so the owner still gets a server to upload them to) and every start stops with one message naming rct2/Data/g1.dat and both ways to supply it (exit 1). The start hosts the park file, or the newest autosave when it's newer (OpenRCT2 autosaves every 5 minutes by default; Ctrl+C doesn't save), or the first RCT2 scenario on a fresh server. userdata/config.ini gets the server name, description, greeting, player cap and listing before every start (ini parser). The start is 'Listening for clients' or the TCP port once bound.
name: OpenRCT2
author: eggs@octail.net
description: OpenRCT2, the open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2: a headless multiplayer server for building a park together. It needs the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files, which can't be shipped: after the install, upload the folder of your own RCT2 install (Data/, ObjData/, Scenarios/ from Steam or GOG) into rct2/ with the file manager, or have staff set the RCT2 data URL to an archive of them and reinstall. Without them the server stops at start with a message saying so.
startup: if [ -z "$(find rct2 -maxdepth 2 -ipath '*/data/g1.dat' -print -quit 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "OpenRCT2 can't start: the RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files are missing (no rct2/Data/g1.dat). Upload the folder of your own RCT2 install (Data/, ObjData/, Scenarios/ from Steam or GOG) into rct2/ with the file manager, or have staff set the RCT2 data URL and reinstall; then start again."; exit 1; fi; PARK="{{PARK_FILE}}"; AUTO=$(ls -t userdata/save/autosave/*.park 2>/dev/null | head -n 1); if [ "{{RESUME_AUTOSAVE}}" = true ] && [ -n "$AUTO" ] && { [ ! -f "$PARK" ] || [ "$AUTO" -nt "$PARK" ]; }; then PARK="$AUTO"; fi; if [ ! -f "$PARK" ]; then PARK=$(find rct2 -maxdepth 2 -iname '*.sc6' | sort | head -n 1); fi; if [ -z "$PARK" ]; then echo 'No park to host: upload a park or scenario to the park file.'; exit 1; fi; echo "Hosting $PARK"; exec ./openrct2-cli host "$PARK" --port {{SERVER_PORT}} --address 0.0.0.0 --headless --user-data-path /home/container/userdata --rct2-data-path /home/container/rct2 $( [ -z "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] || printf -- '--password %s' "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" )

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# OpenRCT2 (Octail's own install script): the official Linux (Debian 12) build from OpenRCT2's GitHub releases (latest
# or a tag), checked against the release's sha256sums.txt and GitHub's digest, failures exit non-zero. Only the
# headless openrct2-cli, libopenrct2.so and OpenRCT2's own data/ are installed.
# OpenRCT2 needs the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files, which Octail can't ship: the operator uploads them to
# rct2/ (the folder with Data/g1.dat) or sets RCT2 data URL to an archive of them on their own storage (optionally
# with its SHA-256). Parks (parks/), the user data (userdata/: config.ini, autosaves, groups and users) and rct2/
# stay on reinstall.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
# Downloads are staged on the server disk: the install container's /tmp is a small tmpfs.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install
trap 'rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install' EXIT
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq unzip tar xz-utils bzip2 ca-certificates > /dev/null

VERSION="${OPENRCT2_VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$VERSION" = "latest" ]; then
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/latest"
else
    API="https://api.github.com/repos/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2/releases/tags/v${VERSION#v}"
fi
if ! RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL "$API"); then
    echo "Installation failed: OpenRCT2 release ${VERSION} wasn't found on GitHub."
    exit 1
fi
TAG=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r '.tag_name')
ASSET="OpenRCT2-${TAG}-Linux-bookworm-x86_64.tar.gz"
SUMS="OpenRCT2-${TAG}-sha256sums.txt"
URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg a "$ASSET" '.assets[] | select(.name == $a) | .browser_download_url')
DIGEST=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg a "$ASSET" '.assets[] | select(.name == $a) | .digest // empty')
SUMS_URL=$(echo "$RELEASE" | jq -r --arg a "$SUMS" '.assets[] | select(.name == $a) | .browser_download_url')
if [ -z "$URL" ] || [ -z "$SUMS_URL" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: release ${TAG} has no ${ASSET} or no ${SUMS}."
    exit 1
fi
SUM=$(curl -fsSL "$SUMS_URL" | awk -v f="$ASSET" '$2 == f || $2 == "./" f { print tolower($1); exit }')
if [ -z "$SUM" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: ${SUMS} doesn't list ${ASSET}."
    exit 1
fi
if [ -n "$DIGEST" ] && [ "${DIGEST#sha256:}" != "$SUM" ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: ${SUMS} and GitHub disagree about ${ASSET}'s SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Downloading ${ASSET}"
curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2.tar.gz "$URL"
if ! echo "${SUM}  /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
    rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2.tar.gz
    echo "Installation failed: the download doesn't match its SHA-256."
    exit 1
fi
rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2 /mnt/server
tar -xzf /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2/OpenRCT2/openrct2-cli ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: ${ASSET} has no openrct2-cli."
    exit 1
fi

cd /mnt/server
rm -rf data
cp -a /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2/OpenRCT2/openrct2-cli /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2/OpenRCT2/libopenrct2.so /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2/OpenRCT2/data /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2 /mnt/server/.octail-install/openrct2.tar.gz
chmod +x openrct2-cli
mkdir -p parks userdata rct2

## The RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files: from the operator's own archive when a URL is set.
if [ -n "${RCT2_DATA_URL:-}" ]; then
    echo "Downloading the RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files from the RCT2 data URL"
    curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data "$RCT2_DATA_URL"
    if [ -n "${RCT2_DATA_SHA256:-}" ]; then
        if ! echo "${RCT2_DATA_SHA256,,}  /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data" | sha256sum -c --quiet -; then
            rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data
            echo "Installation failed: the RCT2 data archive doesn't match its SHA-256."
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x
    if unzip -tq /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data > /dev/null 2>&1 </dev/null; then
        unzip -q -o /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data -d /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x </dev/null
    elif ! tar -xf /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data -C /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x; then
        rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data
        echo "Installation failed: the RCT2 data URL is neither a zip nor a tar archive."
        exit 1
    fi
    rm -f /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-data
    # The folder that holds Data/g1.dat (any letter case), wherever it sits in the archive.
    G1=$(find /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x -ipath '*/data/g1.dat' -print -quit)
    if [ -z "$G1" ]; then
        rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x
        echo "Installation failed: the RCT2 data archive has no Data/g1.dat."
        exit 1
    fi
    cp -a "$(dirname "$(dirname "$G1")")/." /mnt/server/rct2/
    rm -rf /mnt/server/.octail-install/rct2-x
fi
if [ -z "$(find /mnt/server/rct2 -maxdepth 2 -ipath '*/data/g1.dat' -print -quit)" ]; then
    echo "-----------------------------------------"
    echo "NOTE: the RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 data files are not there yet, so the server won't start until they are."
    echo "Upload the folder of your own RCT2 install (Data/, ObjData/, Scenarios/ from Steam or GOG) into rct2/"
    echo "with the file manager, or have staff set the RCT2 data URL and reinstall."
fi

if [ ! -x /mnt/server/openrct2-cli ]; then
    echo "Installation failed: openrct2-cli is missing."
    exit 1
fi

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: OpenRCT2 ${TAG}."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Description
variables.description: Shown in the server list (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Greeting
variables.description: Shown to players when they join (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players may be connected at once (1-255).

variables.name: Public listing
variables.description: true lists the server on the OpenRCT2 master server; false: players join by address.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join. One word, no quotes.

variables.name: Park file
variables.description: The park or scenario to host, relative to the server folder (.park, .sv6, .sc6). Upload your own to parks/.

variables.name: Resume autosave
variables.description: true hosts the newest autosave when it's newer than the park file, so a restart keeps the park's progress; false always hosts the park file.

variables.name: OpenRCT2 version
variables.description: latest or a release such as 0.5.6 (players need the same version). Reinstall to switch.

variables.name: RCT2 data URL
variables.description: Optional, for staff: an https URL of a zip or tar archive of your own RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 files (the folder with Data/g1.dat), unpacked into rct2/ on install. Empty: upload them to rct2/ yourself.

variables.name: RCT2 data SHA-256
variables.description: Optional: the SHA-256 of that archive, checked on install.
